t.en: “Or” within “or”: each level needs a side chosen, and how many steps it takes is not known beforehand. The repeat frame follows only the first result, and stops in a dead end.

A new part, <part-ref to="part:search"></part-ref>: the parts inside take a step, and each result is stepped on again; one path is followed to its end (done, or stuck) before going back for the next. This is <wiki-ref to="dfs"></wiki-ref>. It gives every finished state it finds.

brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.

hint.en: How many steps is the search’s business.
